combinations.obstruction: law horizon of the lattice must pass the first off-line height; fixed pivot index is a zero count, not a horizon gain (verified height)
node count needed is proportional to off-line height and pivot bits are 3.2 to 22 times pi gamma/(4 ln 2); sparser nodes see less
ghost index from a distant box costs one node per intervening zero and about 8 bits per node: a zero count (verified height at higher cost)
energy excess is not specific to a pole and is below noise until T exceeds the off-line height
